13975.zd: 融蚀浆中诞生的小型怪物，威胁性较低。

13993.zd: 沾满融蚀的尾巴将它们粘合在一起，痛苦却无法分离。
13993.ed: The tails covered in Dissolution bonded them together, painful yet inseparable.

14033.zd: 融蚀浆平等地赐予万物终点。我们终为一体。
14033.ed: D-Slime grants all an end equally. We become one.

14034.zd: 身手敏捷的东区街童。开场就会展开迅捷的攻击。
14034.ed: A nimble street kid from the East District. Launches swift attacks right from the start.

14035.zd: 强壮有力的东区街童。攻击能够削弱敌方，并会展开护盾保护自己。
14035.ed: A strong and powerful street kid from the East Side. His attacks weaken the enemy and generate a shield to protect himself.

14036.zd: 身经百战的孩子王。手里的酒瓶会造成伤口。
14036.ed: Battle-hardened King of Children. The bottle in hand can cause wounds.

14051.zd: 满身是融蚀创口的疯马。体型较大，生命力顽强，但融蚀创口也使其更容易受伤。
14051.ed: A crazed horse covered in Dissolution wounds. Larger, resilient, but also more vulnerable due to the wounds.

14057.zd: 曾随着货轮一同沉入深海的水手，这滴痛苦的眼泪与船融为一体，永不分离。
14057.ed: Sailors who sank with the freighter had their tears of pain fuse with the ship, never to part.

14075.zd: 沾满融蚀的尾巴将它们粘合在一起，痛苦却无法分离。

14091.zd: 变形者们选择了这幅躯壳，久远而恒常。当心它们的寄生攻击。
14091.ed: The Shapeshifters have chosen this form, ancient and eternal. Beware their parasitic attacks.

14092.zd: 变形者们选择了这幅躯壳，灵活而坚韧。当心它们的寄生攻击。
14092.ed: The Shapeshifters have chosen this form, agile and resilient. Beware of their parasitic attacks.

14093.zd: 脆弱、游弋的维度碎片，当维度的罅隙被撕裂，它们便会四处飘荡。
14093.ed: Fragile, drifting Dimension Fragments. They wander when the rifts of Dimensions are torn.

14094.zd: 融蚀浆中诞生的中型怪物，攻击时会对敌人的心智进行干扰。
14094.ed: Medium-sized monsters born from D-Slime, whose attacks interfere with the enemy's mind.

14095.zd: 融蚀浆中诞生的中型怪物，攻击时会对敌人的心智进行干扰。
14095.ed: Medium-sized monsters born from D-Slime, whose attacks interfere with the enemy's mind.

14098.zd: 怀揣执念渴望启示的改造人。会呼唤信徒并对其强化。
14098.ed: A reformed being yearning for revelation. It calls upon believers and strengthens them.

22159.zd: 受深海之力影响的复合型融蚀异变体。诃勒特专门提醒过不要给祂们取过于花哨的名字。
22159.ed: A composite-type variant affected by Aequor's power. Czort specifically reminded not to give them overly fanciful names.

34678.zd: 受深海之力影响的干涉型融蚀体，有着不逊于热带珊瑚的美丽。
34678.ed: Interfering dissoluted body influenced by Aequor power, as beautiful as tropical coral.

34681.zd: 受深海之力影响的干涉型融蚀体，有着不逊于热带珊瑚的美丽。
34681.ed: Interfering dissoluted body influenced by Aequor power, as beautiful as tropical coral.

35579.zd: 珊瑚、寄生物……不同的赘生物是否来自同一灾厄的源头？我们无从知晓。
35579.ed: Coral, parasites... Do different hyperplasias come from the same source of Cataclysm? We don't know.

36007.zd: 受「未知」影响后，发生异变的某种海洋生物。软化的外壳与皮肉紧密粘连，强行剥离，只会让它永远失去抵达彼岸的能力。
36007.ed: Affected by "the Unknown", a mutated marine creature. Its softened shell clings tightly to its flesh; forcibly removing it would forever strip away its ability to reach the shore.

36114.zd: 它不受控制地向未知奉献出自己的肉身，没有人在意它的意志。
36114.ed: It uncontrollably dedicates its own flesh to the unknown, with no regard for its will.

36115.ed: Contrary to common sense, it dislikes water.

36118.zd: 它与赘生物融合得是如此恰到好处，美丽到几乎让人以为它本该如此。
36118.ed: It blends with the outgrowth so perfectly, it's almost as if it was meant to be.

44630.zd: 他曾经是个好人，愿意一天工作20个小时，只为「抚养」邻居家的孤儿。
44630.ed: He used to be a good man, willing to work 20 hours a day just to "raise" the neighbor's orphan.

44632.zd: 他曾经是个好人，愿意一天打扫20条街道，只为能让更多人「窥视」到伦蒂尼恩的平静。
44632.ed: He used to be a good person, willing to clean 20 streets a day just to allow more people to "glimpse" the tranquility of Londinium.

72141.zd: 末日已至，残余的灵性相互呼告：请与我产生联络。
72141.ed: The end has arrived. The remaining spirits call out to each other: Please establish a connection with me.

72150.zd: 「姐姐啊，我好想好想再听一次你的声音。」
72150.ed: "Sister, I truly long to hear your voice once more."

72152.zd: 「姐姐啊，我好想好想再听一次你的声音。」
72152.ed: "Sister, I truly long to hear your voice once more."

73521.zd: 总是十分温柔的心理医生，无论何时都保持着得体的微笑。
73521.ed: A consistently gentle psychiatrist, always maintaining an appropriate smile.

80795.zd: 「医生、医生！你明明说过我已经痊愈，为什么我的幻视和幻听仍旧存在？」
80795.ed: "Doctor, Doctor! You clearly said I've already recovered, why do my hallucinations and auditory hallucinations still exist?"

13967.zd: 永恒之国的低级祭司，在得到主祭首肯前，祂们不被允许踏入神殿。
13967.ed: Low-ranking priests of the Eternal Kingdom are not allowed to enter the Temple without the High Priest's approval.

22220.zd: 融蚀与寒冷，伦蒂尼恩深冬的两大死神。
22220.ed: Dissolution and cold, the two Grim Reapers of Londinium's deep winter.

22308.zd: 看起来有些眼熟的眼球状白色脓疱怪物，是不是被冻住了？
22308.ed: Isn't that eyeball-shaped white pustule monster, which looks somewhat familiar, frozen?

44631.zd: 他曾经是个好人，愿意在雨夜守护每一个路人，只为能让所有人「平安归家」。
44631.ed: He used to be a good man, willing to guard every passerby on rainy nights, just to ensure everyone "returns home safely".

47981.zd: 诞生自阴影的「24」。痛恨一切弱小的事物，包括老鼠。
47981.ed: Born from the shadows, "24". Despises all weak things, including mice.

65527.zd: 充满勇气与力量的考察队员。艾尔沃斯最钟爱的祭品。
65527.ed: A courageous and strong expedition member. Elworth's most cherished offering.

65530.zd: 雪山吞噬了那些勇敢无知的人类，他们在死后亦不得安宁。
65530.ed: The snow mountain devoured the brave yet ignorant humans, leaving them unable to find peace even in death.

65532.zd: 当融蚀与冰焰降临这片土地，宁静对艾尔沃斯的生物来说便成为奢望。
65532.ed: When Dissolution and Frostfire arrive on this land, peace becomes a luxury for the creatures of Elworth.

65534.zd: 当融蚀与冰焰降临这片土地，宁静对艾尔沃斯的生物来说便成为奢望。
65534.ed: When Dissolution and Frostfire arrive on this land, peace becomes a luxury for the creatures of Elworth.

72151.zd: 「亲爱的，我还能和你再次拥抱吗？」
72151.ed: "Dear, may I embrace you once more?"

74035.zd: 无法自控陷入癫狂的莎拉，额角的伤疤透露出一丝银色的瘢痕。
74035.ed: Unable to control herself, Sarah falls into Madness. The scar on her forehead reveals a hint of silver.

94942.zd: 他们执行神明的意志，没有人在意生存与毁灭，没有人在意错误与正确。
94942.ed: They carry out the will of the gods; no one cares about survival or destruction, no one cares about error or correctness.

13960.zd: 小乔治的无数个前身之一。再悉心的保存也经不住长期磨损。
13960.ed: One of Little George's countless former selves. No amount of careful preservation can withstand long-term wear and tear.

13962.zd: 身上满是融蚀痕的流浪犬，它的攻击迅猛而连续。
13962.ed: A stray dog covered in D-Marks attacked fiercely and continuously.

13963.zd: 身着过气礼装的傲慢淑女，千万别给她看最新款的穿搭杂志。
13963.ed: A haughty lady dressed in outdated attire. Never show her the latest fashion magazines.

13974.zd: 融蚀浆中诞生的小型怪物，威胁性较低。
13974.ed: Small monsters born from D-Slime, posing a lesser threat.

13984.zd: 被融蚀浆蚀化的人类，形貌凄惨。
13984.ed: Humans dissolved by D-Slime appear miserable.

13991.zd: 裁缝被融蚀侵蚀了理智，剪刀剪开的不再是布料，而是血肉。攻击频率较高。
13991.ed: A tailor driven mad by Dissolution, cutting Caro instead of fabric. High Attack frequency.

14047.zd: 红酒、甜品、美好的恋爱都已离她远去。站在你面前的，是一位充满怨念的失意者。
14047.ed: Wine, desserts, and sweet romance are all distant memories for her. Standing before you is a resentful and disheartened soul.

14056.zd: 总是弯着腰的沉默绅士，只在需要时为女伴献上溢美之词。
14056.ed: A silent gentleman who always stoops, offering compliments to his lady only when necessary.

14065.zd: 这肯定只是融蚀浆而已。别去思考其中包含着什么。
14065.ed: This must be just D-slime. Don't think about what's inside.

14085.zd: 曾有56人在她的悉心照料下死亡。会保护其他友方个体。
14085.ed: 56 people have died under her care. She will protect other friendly units.

14096.zd: 如同手术刀一般精准、冷酷。攻击力很高的个体。
14096.ed: As precise and ruthless as a scalpel. An individual with very high Attack.

14111.zd: 提灯教会象征物的具象化。请勿追究其灵知的来源。
14111.ed: A manifestation of the Temple Light Church's symbol. Do not question the source of its Gnosis.

22307.zd: 看起来有些眼熟的眼球状白色脓疱怪物，居然真的不怕冷啊！
22307.ed: A somewhat familiar eye-shaped white pustule monster. It really isn't afraid of the cold!

22335.zd: 曾饱读苏格拉底，曾信仰弗洛伊德。可惜的是，现在脑子里只剩尖叫的歇斯底里。
22335.ed: Once well-versed in Socrates and a believer in Freud, my mind is now filled with nothing but hysterical screams.

22336.zd: 主动离开的歇斯底里患者，已经分不清现实与记忆的区别。
22336.ed: The hysterical patient who left voluntarily can no longer distinguish between reality and memory.

49240.zd: 亚兰人拥有异常的繁衍能力，但亚兰的战士依然是某人的儿子，某人的父亲。
49240.ed: The Aram people possess extraordinary reproductive abilities, yet Aram warriors are still someone's sons and fathers.

52491.ed: The Aram people possess extraordinary reproductive abilities, yet Aram warriors are still someone's sons and fathers.

53764.ed: A silent gentleman who always stoops, offering compliments to his lady only when necessary.

59747.zd: 从这些来自异维的怪物身上，你看到了属于弥萨格的标志。
59747.ed: From these interdimensional monsters, you see the emblem of Mythag.

72142.zd: 诞生于灰烬之中，已经被融蚀磨灭大部分灵性。
72142.ed: Born from the ashes, most of its spirituality has already been dissolved and erased.

72145.zd: 末日已至，残余的灵性相互呼告：请与我的灵性融为一体。
72145.ed: The end has arrived. The remaining spiritual essences call out to one another: Please merge with my spiritual essence.

79935.ed: The "@2 Ritual" represents the early humanity, transcending its own levels, stepping into the threshold of life evolution.

79941.ed: The "@2 Ritual" represents the later humanity. In the agony of flesh melting, it will inevitably transcend the limits of humanity.

80817.ed: In the twisted rebirth, it transcended itself, acquiring the most perfect life form.

91739.zd: 「我会夺回我们的自由，波吕克斯……」

94680.zd: 葬骸城秘术制造出的产物。一位一往无前的战士，一道差强人意的甜点。
94680.ed: A product of Necrovia's secret arts: a fearless warrior, a passable dessert.

94700.zd: 蹈海者用葬骸城秘术制造出的产物，拥有蹈海者需要的一切……除了信仰。
94700.ed: Created by the Seafarers with Necrovia's forbidden arts, containing everything a Seafarer needs...except faith.

94715.zd: 葬骸城随处可见的居民，拙劣的食客，粗粝的食材。
94715.ed: Residents of Necrovia are everywhere—awkward diners and coarse ingredients.

94716.zd: 没有任何可为人称道的天赋，只有甘愿为王城献身的勇气。
94716.ed: No remarkable talents to speak of, only the courage to willingly sacrifice oneself for the Royal City.

94718.zd: 葬骸城随处可见的居民，拙劣的食客，粗粝的食材。
94718.ed: Residents of Necrovia are everywhere—awkward diners and coarse ingredients.

14011.zd: 为了希望守护的人，她也可以变得坚强。请确保有足够的算力来应对其凝滞诅咒。
14011.ed: For those she wishes to protect, she can become strong. Ensure sufficient Arithmetica to counter her stasis curse.

14015.zd: 自其他维度撕裂缝隙而来的追逐之足，捕捉每个冒失的灵魂。
14015.ed: The feet of pursuit that tear through dimensions, capturing every reckless soul.

14026.zd: 雕塑家协会的改造产物，受过洗脑而充满信念，越战越勇。
14026.ed: A remade creation of the Sculptors' Association, brainwashed and filled with conviction, growing stronger with each battle.

14049.zd: 眼球状的黑色脓疱怪物。

14099.zd: 游离的维度碎片拼合而成的异兽，与祂的战利品和谐相处。
14099.ed: A strange beast pieced together from free-floating dimensional fragments, coexisting harmoniously with its spoils.

22221.ed: Dissolution and cold, the two Grim Reapers of Londinium's deep winter.

22337.ed: A hysterical patient abandoned by their loved one, unable to distinguish between reality and memory.

56172.ed: In the poem's Cité, they follow in Colette's footsteps.

59743.ed: The lower-tier members are thrilled by this rare and significant operation.

65533.ed: He refused to abandon his teammates buried by the mountains. He bravely turned back and succeeded.
